endorsements.name: Nan Wang (sakura) & Ziling Chen (R1nd0)
endorsements.label: Enhanced Insecurity Mode: 23 RCEs in Edge's "Safe" WebAssembly Interpreter
endorsements.description: Microsoft Edge's Enhanced Security Mode was designed as the ultimate defense when browsing unfamiliar websites. By disabling JIT compilation and forcing all WebAssembly code through an interpreter called DrumBrake, Microsoft promised protection against the most common classes of browser exploitation. The irony? This security feature became a massive attack surface itself. Read more
